issues.description: Animal constructor and name accessor visibility is inconsistent: the UML/problem text specify protected visibility for Animal(String), getName(), and setName(String) (shown with '#' in UML and stated explicitly), but the provided solution implements all three as public. This can mislead students about the required encapsulation and may cause their submissions to fail if tests enforce the specified protected visibility.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution match the specification by changing Animal(String), getName(), and setName(String) in Animal.java to protected (keeping name private), or alternatively update the UML/problem statement to declare these members public if that is the intended design.
